verdicts.reason: Greeting answered with a welcome and a sensible opening question.
User confirmed first visit; bot moves on to ask what they need help with.
User answered the reason question; bot proceeds to the next step, asking about a doctor.
Doctor name given was not recognized; a plain re-ask of the doctor question is sensible.
User named the doctor; bot moves to asking which days, compatible with the mornings note.
Ignores the user asking if this is a real person, and re-asks the doctor question already answered.

User said Friday mornings; bot offers Friday morning slots with that doctor.
Ignores the request for a 9am slot and re-asks the doctor question already settled.
Asks which days again although the user already said Friday earlier in the conversation.
User said Friday; bot offers Friday slots with the named doctor.
User chose the 10:00 slot; bot confirms that exact slot.
